AAY.caption: One Time
AAY.doc: Furthermore, if you register the same property multiple times, the next event will use the new value of that property. If you want to register a property only once, set this field to `true`.
AAY.name: isOnce

AAZ.caption: Properties
AAZ.doc: You can send parameters with their values.
AAZ.name: properties

AAa.caption: Add Super Properties _________________________________________________________
AAa.doc: Super Properties are properties associated with events that are set once and then sent with every capture call
AAa.name: info

AAb.caption: Note _________________________________________________________
AAb.doc: However, please note that this does not store properties against the User, only against their events.
AAb.name: info_note

AAm.caption: Properties JSON
AAm.doc: Optional. A JSON object as text, for example {"plan_count": 3, "is_trial": true}. Unlike the key/value list, JSON keeps numbers, booleans and lists typed. Merged over the Properties list; invalid JSON is ignored with a console warning.
AAm.name: properties_json
